text: People seldom know how to employ their time to the best advantage till they have too little left to employ; but if, at your age, in the beginning of life, people would but consider the value of it, and put every moment to interest, it is incredible what an additional fund of knowledge and pleasure such an economy would bring in.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter CLXVIII, to his son, London, May 31, Old Style 1752
